reviews.author: Sana Hoda
reviews.text:
We cannot thank the team at Happy Paws Veterinary Clinic LLC enough for the exceptional care they gave our cat, Lucky. The veterinarians and staff took the time to explain everything clearly on every visit, answered all our questions, and made what could have been a stressful experience so much easier for both us and our sweet little boy.
It truly means the world to know your beloved pet is in kind and capable hands. We are so grateful for their professionalism, warmth, and the obvious love they have for the animals they care for. We would recommend Happy Paws Veterinary Clinic LLC to any pet parent without hesitation. Thank you for taking such wonderful care of our family. 🐾

reviews.author: Princess Ponce
reviews.text: Thank you so much to the amazing team at Happy Paws for your incredible service! I lost my beloved cat Ashley for 380 long days. A kind rescuer, Ms. Amita, found her and brought her to your clinic. Because Ashley already had her microchip registered with you—and I'd previously informed the clinic that she was missing—they contacted me right away when she arrived. I'm incredibly grateful that we had her microchipped before she got lost; it made all the difference in bringing her home safely. Thank you from the bottom of my heart! 🐾❤️

reviews.author: Ynah Libunao
reviews.text: As a furmom of 4, I am very thankful for Happy Paws for being a vet clinic with a heart. They have genuine compassion to not only the pets but the owners as well. My visit and experience has always been a treat. The owners, the staff and doctors are pleasing to deal with. They are very accomodating, responsive and with good quality of service - very good value for money. There will be no reason for a furparent to not be responsible as their price point is also pocket friendly.

reviews.text: I visited Happy paws clinic and they were really professional and friendly. I did my cat’s castration and it was very easy procedure. Very affordable prices. I attended many clinics which charged me unnecessarily. Thank you and i will continue with your clinic.

reviews.author: jfer Perez
reviews.text:
🐾✨ **Lucy’s Journey with Happy Paws** ✨🐾TESTIMONY

What a whirlwind it’s been with my sweet Lucy! It all started when I noticed her ear was swollen, and my heart sank. I knew we had to see Dr. Dhan at Happy Paws. During our first visit, he carefully examined Lucy and suspected an ear hematoma. He explained everything with such compassion and professionalism, guiding us through the treatment options. I felt hopeful when he mentioned we could start with medicine and that surgery might not be necessary.

We went home, optimistic and armed with a treatment plan. For a week, I watched Lucy closely, hoping to see improvement. But as fate would have it, her ear swelled up again. Feeling anxious, I returned to Happy Paws for another check-up. Dr. Dhan’s reassurance made all the difference as we decided to go ahead with the surgery.

The day of the surgery was nerve-wracking, but the team was amazing. They kept me updated throughout the process, sending messages and even videos to show how Lucy was doing. It truly helped ease my worries during a tough time.

When I finally brought Lucy home, I was filled with relief and gratitude. She started to heal quickly, and after a week, we returned to have her stitches removed. Watching her regain her playful spirit has been the highlight of my days!

Now, Lucy is almost fully recovered and back to her mischievous self. While her ear may look a little different, her health and happiness are what matter most. I can’t thank Dr. Dhan and the entire Happy Paws team enough for their exceptional care and support throughout this journey.

You’ve made a lasting impact on our lives, and I’m forever grateful!
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you so much Ms. Jenifer for choosing Happy Paws and for sharing Lucy’s journey with us and the community. We are overjoyed as your feedback motivates us to keep raising the bar and sets the standard for excellence in everything we do. Thank you again for your 5⭐️ rating and for being an amazing part of our journey as well. 😊💜💛

reviews.author: Arjun Singh
reviews.text: 1st of all this clinic is not working 24 hours. The contact info is absolutely incorrect whether it’s online or offline on the board. It’s 7AM i am standing outside with a injured cat nobody is here. I mean how the hell they can show they are 24 hours open. I came from very far and the cat is in pain.
reviews.owner_reply:
We are truly sorry for your experience, Mr. Singh, especially when you were seeking urgent care for an injured cat. We understand your frustration and sincerely apologize.

Our veterinary schedule recently changed, and we have updated our online information to reflect this. Since vet unavailability can’t be shown online, we recommend calling ahead for guidance during times when we can only assist with food and medication.

We hope you’ll give us another chance to care for your furry friends. 🙏🏻
